mina (Eng Manager): Quick Q  considering promoting Jordan L3->L4 effective 2026-09-01. We want a 9% base increase + small one-time RSU. Can we do this mid-cycle and avoid comp committee?

leo (People Ops): Congrats! Mid-cycle promotions are allowed. If the base increase <=10% and the new salary remains within band, you typically don't need the comp committee. Equity still needs an Equity Grant Request.

tara (Compensation): To add: if the bump pushes them above band midpoint or includes market uplift beyond band, committee required. Also attach 3 concrete impact examples in the promo note.

mina (Eng Manager): Understood. What's the minimal packet to submit to avoid back-and-forth?

leo (People Ops): Minimal: 1) manager justification (1-paragraph + 3 bullets), 2) updated scorecard, 3) current vs proposed comp table, 4) equity ask outline, 5) effective date and payroll code. If international, add HRBP note.

miro (hr-bot): Payroll cutoff reminder: September effective changes must be submitted by 2026-08-18 17:00 PDT to hit Sept payroll. Late approvals will apply to the following payroll.

mina (Eng Manager): If we submit today and approvals finish before cutoff, any other approvals needed? Director sign-off? VP?

tara (Compensation): Manager + director approvals are enough for <=10% in-band moves. If >10% or above midpoint, need director + comp committee + finance. Finance needs GL code and run-rate impact.

sam (Finance): From finance: include the GL and cost center. If total comp change (base+equity run-rate) > $8k annual, flag for a quarterly forecast update.

mina (Eng Manager): Good to know. Question: equity grant date - can we align it to the effective date or does it need to be the submission date?

tara (Compensation): Equity grant date can be the effective date if the grant is approved within 30 days of that date and stock admin signs off. Otherwise grant date will be submission date.

mina (Eng Manager): One more: sample line for manager justification? Want short and evidence-based.

leo (People Ops): Try: "Recommend promotion of Jordan to L4 effective 2026-09-01 for expanded ownership of search infra (reduced latency 25%), led cross-team rollout impacting 3 products, and consistent mentorship of peers. Request +9% base (in-band) and one-time RSU refresh to align to L4 median."

agnes (HRBP): I'll review the draft before you submit. If you want a quick pre-check, paste the promo note here and I can flag any labor/contract notes.

mina (Eng Manager): Will do, thanks everyone. I'll post the draft in 30m and tag @tara for compensation check. :thanks:
